why_ai: A licensed attorney must advise, sign and appear, though routine wills and simple matters face AI self-help.
why_clarity: Mixed matters across practice areas, with outcomes set by courts and counterparties months later.
why_digital: Documents drive the work, but clients are local and court appearances are in person.

why_ai: Contract abstraction and diligence review at scale are the tasks generative AI replaces first.
why_clarity: Abstraction against defined term sets repeats across huge contract volumes and is quality-checkable.
why_digital: Contracts in, abstracts and reports out, delivered offshore and remotely.

why_ai: AI assistants answering legal questions and recommending counsel threaten directory traffic directly.
why_clarity: Lead matching and pricing run on continuous enquiries with conversion measured quickly.
why_digital: Online directories and lead marketplaces, entirely digital.

why_ai: Admission to practise is set by state supreme courts and cannot be replaced by software.
why_clarity: Psychometric item development, scoring and equating follow codified methods each administration.
why_digital: Item banks digital, exams sat in person, candidates bound to their jurisdiction.

why_ai: Time capture, invoicing, reminders and trust reconciliation are rule-based tasks software automates.
why_clarity: Invoices and three-way trust reconciliations either tie out or fail immediately.
why_digital: Time and payment data in, invoices and reconciliations out.

why_ai: Intake qualification follows structured decision trees that AI voice and chat agents run fully.
why_clarity: Practice area, jurisdiction and limitation checks are explicit and conversion is measured fast.
why_digital: Calls and web enquiries in, qualified consultations booked online.

why_ai: Clause extraction and risk flagging are machine learning products with no human gate.
why_clarity: Clause classification against taxonomies is labelled, repeatable and measurable.
why_digital: Contracts in, extracted clauses and scores out inside software.

why_ai: Constitutionally required counsel appears in court and visits jailed clients, with liberty at stake.
why_clarity: Plea and trial outcomes depend on prosecutors and judges, case by case.
why_digital: Paper files, jail visits and courtroom appearances with locally referred clients.

why_ai: Generative AI review is replacing review attorneys, leaving hosting and defensibility work.
why_clarity: Responsiveness and privilege calls repeat at enormous volume and are sampled for accuracy.
why_digital: Electronic evidence in, production sets out, all on screen.

why_ai: Clients in crisis need a trusted licensed attorney through adversarial custody and divorce litigation.
why_clarity: Support worksheets are formulaic, but custody and settlement outcomes are contested and slow.
why_digital: Financial documents in, but hearings, mediation and client contact are local and in person.

why_ai: A licensed solo personally advises and appears, but simple wills and closings face AI self-help.
why_clarity: Radical generalism means each matter differs, with outcomes known only later.
why_digital: Documents on screen, but local clients, phone calls and court dates dominate.

why_ai: Attorneys of record carry high personal stakes for clients, though form-driven processing automates.
why_clarity: Government workflows have predictable milestones, but adjudication outcomes arrive months later.
why_digital: Forms filed electronically, with consultations and community referrals partly in person.

why_ai: Confidential financial submissions gathered over decades form a dataset AI cannot reproduce.
why_clarity: Defined rate and performance metrics published annually, with accuracy never verified externally.
why_digital: Survey submissions in, benchmark reports out.

why_ai: Partner compensation, succession and mergers are politically sensitive calls made through trusted advisers.
why_clarity: Each engagement is bespoke, and whether a compensation system worked shows years later.
why_digital: Firm financials analysed on screen, with partner meetings and retreats partly in person.

why_ai: Line-item adjudication against billing guidelines is rule-based review machines perform.
why_clarity: Each invoice line is checked against explicit guidelines with immediate reduce-or-accept outcomes.
why_digital: Electronic invoices in, adjudications and reports out.

why_ai: Regulated insurers price on unique claims data and defend claims, though small-firm underwriting automates.
why_clarity: Actuarial pricing methods are codified, but claims develop over years.
why_digital: Applications and claims data in, policies out, sold through brokers and online.

why_ai: Benchmark reports and dashboards from platform data are routine analytics AI produces.
why_clarity: Monthly billing data gives defined metrics recomputed constantly.
why_digital: Matter and billing records in, dashboards and reports out.

why_ai: Lawyers sanctioned for hallucinated citations pay for trusted citators, though LLMs erode editorial summarisation.
why_clarity: Every decision is headnoted and classified into a fixed taxonomy at huge volume.
why_digital: Court opinions in, online research databases out by subscription.

why_ai: Normalised state trial court records from thousands of systems are a hard-won data asset.
why_clarity: Docket normalisation repeats daily, while judge analytics are descriptive rather than verifiable.
why_digital: Court dockets in, analytics out online.

why_ai: Attorney-closing states require a licensed attorney to supervise closings, though the workflow automates.
why_clarity: Each closing is a defined project with standardised documents and strict deadlines.
why_digital: Title and loan documents in software, closings at a table, referrals from local realtors.

why_ai: Licensed litigators carry adversarial disputes through depositions and trial before judges.
why_clarity: Phases are predictable, but outcomes are decided by courts and opponents months later.
why_digital: Discovery and briefs on screen, depositions and hearings in person, clients local.

why_ai: County-by-county title plants are a durable asset, while examination is increasingly automated.
why_clarity: Chain-of-title searches follow defined procedures on every closing, with defects surfacing later.
why_digital: Recorded instruments, some on paper, in; title reports out; markets are county-specific.
